资源组名称不能为空: Resource group name cannot be empty
资源组名称只能包含字母、数字和下划线: Resource group name can only contain letters, numbers, and underscores
请至少配置一个资源限制: Configure at least one resource limit
相对权重，数值越大获得的 CPU 时间越多: Relative weight; a higher value gets more CPU time
为该资源组独占的 CPU 核心数: Number of CPU cores exclusively reserved for this resource group
独占 CPU 核数不能小于 0: Exclusive CPU cores cannot be less than 0
支持百分比或绝对值，如: 50% 或 10GB: Supports percentage or absolute value, e.g., 50% or 10GB
内存使用超过此阈值时开始落盘: Spilling starts when memory usage exceeds
请输入最大并发查询数: Enter the maximum number of concurrent queries
请输入扫描行数上限: Enter the maximum number of scanned rows
分类器用于自动将查询分配到此资源组。您可以根据用户名、角色名、查询类型、来源 I: Classifiers automatically assign queries to this resource group. You can configure them by username, role name, query type, source IP, or database name.
点击上方\"添加分类器\"按钮开始配置: Spilling starts when memory usage exceeds this threshold
当前没有资源组在使用资源: Maximum number of queries running simultaneously

最大内存 (MB): Maximum rows scanned for a single query

请至少配置一个资源限制（CPU 权重、独占 CPU 核数、内存限制或并发限制）: Configure at least one resource limit (CPU weight, exclusive CPU cores, memory limit, or concurrency limit)
请至少添加一个分类器，否则查询无法分配到此资源组: Add at least one classifier, otherwise queries cannot be assigned to this resource group
加载资源组使用情况失败: Failed to load resource usage analysis
CPU 权重上限由集群平均 BE CPU 核数决定；保存时由集群校验。: The CPU-weight ceiling is the average BE CPU core count and is validated by the cluster when saved.
CPU 权重与独占 CPU 核数只能有一个为正数。CPU 权重为共享调度份额；独: Only one of CPU weight and exclusive CPU cores can be positive. CPU weight is a shared scheduling share; exclusive cores are reserved for and limit this resource group.
默认开启 enable_resource_group_cpu_borrowing: With enable_resource_group_cpu_borrowing enabled by default, Shared groups can borrow CPUs from an idle Exclusive group. For strict isolation, assess and disable this BE setting first.
自动落盘仅在系统变量 spill_mode=auto 时生效；此阈值触发中间结果: Automatic spilling works only when spill_mode=auto. This threshold spills intermediate results; it is not a hard memory limit.
资源组并发阈值用于 Query Queue v1；需同时启用相应全局查询队列和: Resource-group concurrency thresholds apply to Query Queue v1 and require the relevant global query queue plus enable_group_level_query_queue. Query Queue v2 schedules with logical slots; confirm the current mode first.
大查询限制仅在值大于 0 时生效，按每个 BE 计算；任一限制被超过时，查询会终: Large-query limits apply only when greater than 0 and are evaluated per BE. Exceeding any limit terminates the query with an error.
CPU 权重与独占 CPU 核数不能同时为正数: CPU weight and exclusive CPU cores cannot both be positive
必须且只能配置一个 CPU 调度模式: Configure exactly one CPU scheduling mode
必须配置一个 CPU 调度模式: A CPU scheduling mode is required
创建时至少添加一个分类器: At least one classifier is required when creating a resource group
创建资源组时必须至少添加一个分类器: Add at least one classifier when creating a resource group
资源组在每个 BE 查询内存池中的占比，必须设置。: Required share of each BE query memory pool available to this resource group.
大查询在每个 BE 上可使用的内存上限，单位为字节。: Maximum memory a large query can use on each BE, in bytes.
创建普通资源组时必须至少配置一个分类器。创建后仍可在会话中使用 SET reso: A normal resource group requires at least one classifier at creation. It can still be selected in a session with SET resource_group afterward.
审计日志用于识别历史工作负载，不能推导资源组配额。CPU、内存和并发限制均按每个: Audit logs identify historical workload, but cannot derive resource-group quotas. CPU, memory, and concurrency limits apply per BE; configure them manually from current BE capacity, workload peaks, and load tests.
历史 CPU 份额可用于识别高消耗用户；它不是 CPU 权重或独占核数建议。: Historical CPU share identifies high-consumption users; it is not a CPU-weight or exclusive-core recommendation.
此处为单个查询的历史峰值内存，不能代表资源组在单个 BE 上的并发内存需求。: This is the historical peak for one query, not the resource group's concurrent memory requirement on one BE.
此速率由同一分钟内完成的 SELECT 审计记录折算，不能代表同时运行的查询数。: This rate is derived from completed SELECT audit records in the same minute and is not a count of simultaneously running queries.
仅支持 SELECT 和 INSERT；INSERT 同时覆盖 INSERT I: Only SELECT and INSERT are supported. INSERT covers compute isolation for both INSERT INTO and Broker Load. When multiple classifiers match, the highest match score wins; ties may be chosen at random.
